title: lilium bulbiferum subsp. croceum
intro: Lilium bulbiferum subsp. croceum, commonly known as the Orange Lily, is a subspecies of lily native to the Mediterranean region. It is a bulbous perennial plant with bright orange flowers, often used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Lilium bulbiferum subsp. croceum include sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help alleviate anxiety and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, such as lycorine and galanthamine, which have been studied for their medicinal properties.
